informal_statement: The defined 8-twist/three-direction counting model gives leading inverse coupling 137. Source theorems check a fixed reported residual 0.035999 inside the rational interval (1/64, 0.04814). The approximately 137.032 structural value is reported; identification with measured, scale-dependent coupling remains open.

approximation_or_regime.description: The 137 and 137.032 values are leading/structural; the residual running and the coupling/scale map are not derived.
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: No claim is made about the full renormalized alpha at a specified scale until the count-to-coupling bridge is supplied.

formal_statement.statement_scope: Finite identities and order/interval statements about the 8-twist count; not a derivation of the physical coupling.

formal_object.type: finite counting model + rational interval + arithmetic identity

interpretation.map: The 8-twist count and the 3D directional tensor are identified with the leading electromagnetic coupling; the residual weight is identified with the vacuum-polarization multiplicity.
interpretation.formal_status: The count-to-renormalized-coupling map is not formalized; the identification is a bridge.
interpretation.noncircularity_test: The coupling/scale map and the w value must be specified independently of the CODATA comparison before the comparison is counted as a prediction.

strange_loop.name: 8-twist census -> residual multiplicity -> renormalized coupling at a scale
levels: renormalized coupling at a stated scale
strange_loop.conservative_return: The leading 137 and the formal comparator-residual band (1/64, 0.04814) are finitary; 137.032 is reported/structural, and the count-to-coupling scale map is not a proved return.
strange_loop.noncircularity_witness: The scale/scheme and w must be fixed before CODATA; w = 1/2 is structural, but the multiplicity/resummation is open.
strange_loop.defeater: A post-hoc w, an undeclared scale/scheme, or a confirmed alpha variation.

measurement_protocol.failure_condition: A confirmed alpha variation, or a failed count-to-coupling map, or a comparison that requires post-hoc adjustment of w.
